_about: Design and check rules per manufacturing process. Used by tools/partcheck.py and tools/make_viewer.py; mirrored for the CAD side in lib/process.scad (keep the two in step). Wall limits follow what the services' own checks reject (red) and flag (warn). Rates are rough per-cm3 figures from real JLC quotes; always upload the file for a real price. short, for and look are the plain-words name, the one-line purpose and the material look the preview page uses.

resin_sla.name: Resin (SLA), prototype
resin_sla.for: A cheap, quick test print to check fit and feel before the real thing. Brittle, and not for life outdoors.
notes: The service adds and removes supports itself; overhangs are not your problem, trapped resin is.
A closed cavity holds liquid resin. Every hollow needs a drain hole of at least 2 mm.
Brittle and UV-sensitive. Tests fit, feel and function, not life outdoors. Hand-tight only.

fdm_asa.name: FDM, ASA plastic, final part
fdm_asa.for: A tough plastic that lasts outdoors in sun and water. The usual choice for a finished plastic part.
notes: Walls: under one 0.4 mm line cannot print; under two lines (0.8) prints weak.
Print with the largest flat face on the bed; chamfer the bed edge 0.6-1 mm against elephant foot.
Flat ceilings bridge fine up to about 10 mm; past that, slope them 45 degrees.
Horizontal holes over 6 mm: teardrop them (hole_x in process.scad).
Layer lines are the weak direction: load across them, not along them.
Rate is filament only, at 100 % fill (upper bound).

slm_316l.name: Metal (SLM), 316L stainless
slm_316l.for: Printed metal for parts that must be strong, take heat or last for decades. Priced by how much metal is in it.
notes: No flat ceilings: every downward face steeper than 45 degrees, or a support nobody can reach inside.
Powder must pour out: no closed cavities.
Threads print rough on the downward flanks: print loose (0.45) and chase with a tap.
Food-equipment alloy; no galling against brass; fine outdoors. Not a certified drinking-water fitting.
Rate: JLC quote, 38 cm3 part at $67.

slm_alsi10mg.name: Metal (SLM), aluminium AlSi10Mg
slm_alsi10mg.for: Printed metal at about half the weight and price of steel. Needs care against corrosion next to brass or steel in water.
notes: Same geometry rules as 316L.
Against brass, nickel or steel in water it corrodes slowly: PTFE tape on threads, anodize if offered, dry it over winter.
Rate: JLC quote, 38 cm3 part at $41.

mjf_pa12.name: Nylon (MJF/SLS), PA12
mjf_pa12.for: A tough, slightly flexible plastic printed in powder, so any shape prints without supports.
notes: Self-supporting in its powder bed: any overhang prints.
Powder must escape: hollows need two openings of 4 mm or more.
Tougher than resin and fine outdoors; slightly porous, so seal with a gasket, not the surface.
